headline: Global oil stocks tumble as crude prices retreat after U.S. halts Iran strikes
summary: Investing.com -- Shares in oil and gas producers across the U.S. and Europe fell sharply after the U.S. military halted two weeks of strikes on Iran, with Tehran signaling it would suspend its own attacks as long as the pause holds, easing fears of a broader Middle East escalation and dragging crude prices lower.

headline: Oil Prices Slide as Trump Touts Possible Negotiations With Iran
summary: Oil prices fell sharply Monday as strikes between the U.S. and Iran remained paused for a third day and President Donald Trump told reporters aboard Air Force One there was a “good chance that something good could happen” with Iran.  The price of most-active  Brent crude  futures, the international benchmark, settled down 12% to $86.49 a barrel Monday.  West Texas Intermediate  the U.S. standard, settled down 7.5% at $82.61 a barrel.
